property_summary: Invariant: after any successful setOwner(newOwner) call, the caller must always be the original deployer (admin); the mutant lets the current owner (who may not be the deployer) successfully call setOwner, so there exist inputs where setOwner succeeds but the caller != deployer.
change_summary: Modified onlyAdmin modifier to compare msg.sender to owner instead of admin, so setOwner's onlyAdmin check (which uses this modifier) allows the current owner rather than the original admin to call it.
